• Type: Stem
  • Origin: Africa
  • Growth rate: Medium
  • Height: 20 - 30+ cm
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Medium
Grows best in soft and slightly acidic water. Make sure the lower leaves get sufficient light or they will die off. Easy to propagate by side shoots or cuttings which you replant in the bottom.

Ammannia crassicaulis from Africa is a beautiful and highly recommended aquarium plant, although it has high light demands. It has red-brown, cognac-coloured leaves. Stems become 30-50 cm and 8-15 cm wide. In the aquarium it can be recognized by its yellow-green stems.
